house_style: Realistic documentary-style painting for a high school watershed mystery, like a field photo: natural daylight, true colors, clear subject, calm, deserted. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: One set of eight sibling suspect cards, every scene in the same painted style and framing, the suspect clearly in the middle of the picture.

assets.name: pasture
assets.prompt: Brown cattle standing in a shallow creek in a green pasture, trampled muddy banks, summer.
assets.sd: Four brown cattle standing knee-deep in the middle of a shallow muddy creek that winds through a green summer pasture, trampled muddy banks with hoof prints, a few trees in the distance.

assets.name: fields
assets.prompt: Flat young cornfields in early summer with a round drainage tile pipe outlet sticking out of a ditch bank, clear water flowing from the pipe into the ditch.

assets.name: construction
assets.prompt: A graded bare brown soil construction site next to a small creek, a muddy runoff channel carrying brown water down into the creek, a parked yellow excavator in the distance, cloudy day.

assets.name: storm-drain
assets.prompt: A round concrete storm drain outfall pipe in the bank under a small town bridge, water pouring from the pipe into a creek after rain, wet stones, overcast light.
assets.sd: A large round concrete pipe opening set in a plain concrete wall in a creek bank, a strong stream of brown rainwater pouring out of the dark pipe opening into a creek below, wet stones, the underside of a small concrete road bridge overhead, overcast sky after rain.

assets.name: sewer
assets.prompt: An old round brick manhole with a plain rusty iron lid on a grassy creek bank, damp dark ground around it, the creek beside it, a few small town houses in the background.

assets.name: plant
assets.prompt: Aerial view of a small town wastewater treatment plant beside a river: several round clarifier tanks with water, rectangular aeration basins, a few low buildings, green grass around it.

assets.name: geese
assets.prompt: A flock of Canada geese on a sandy lake beach, black necks and heads with white chinstraps, brown bodies, calm water behind them, morning light.

assets.name: beach
assets.prompt: A small lake beach on a summer afternoon: an empty tall white wooden lifeguard chair on the sand, calm blue water, empty smooth sand, trees along the far shore.
